verdict.rationale: Railway's own site says you connect your repo and it handles the rest with auto-config, and settings can be changed on the canvas with YAML optional. That directly covers repo-connected deploys without manual build configuration. The support is homepage marketing copy only; the outage comments in the pack are off-topic and were ignored. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how builds and languages are auto-detected, and independent or hands-on confirmation of zero-config deploys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest. Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
Modify settings directly from the canvas. YAML optional.
